thread:
emily_cs: Sapphire (retail) reached out asking to onboard an adaptive reranker for search personalization. Key asks: run `sapphirerank-v2` (13B) with 4-bit quantized weights, strict PII/PHI redaction, p95 latency SLO ~150ms for rerank calls. They prefer Dedicated but could go Private. They can share ~50k labeled query->click pairs. Who can own eligibility + eval plan? cc @raj_eng @li_research @olivia_se

raj_eng: I can take infra lead. Need to confirm model artifact size and perf estimates. Does their dataset contain raw PHI or only hashed identifiers?

emily_cs: dataset has hashed user ids but product says they'll include a handful of PHI examples for edge cases. Link to data (S3): https://files.redwood.com/sapphire/sapphirerank-50k.csv — will request sanitized subset for initial eval.

li_research: I'll own the evals. Plan: offline relevance metrics (NDCG@10, MRR) + safety/regression tests around redaction. Also run latency profiles on Dedicated 2xA100 config. ETA: baseline within 3 business days once we have the sanitized sample and model artifact.

olivia_se: Security note: any PHI means we need DPA + ensure KMS-backed keys + audit logging. For PHI-involved workloads we recommend Private or Dedicated with customer-approved data controls. Also need model card and data handling Q&A. Tagging legal.

sam_success: flagging renewal risk — Sapphire's renewal is in ~7 weeks and they said inference SLA is a gating factor. If we can't meet latency/cost targets they may delay. Prioritize this in the onboarding queue. :warning:

marta_ops: For Dedicated POC we can reserve a 2-GPU pool temporarily. Need expected QPS and test harness. Will produce a cost ballpark once we know run duration.

raj_eng: For hitting 150ms p95 we'll need to validate sequence lengths and batch sizing. Li, can you get token length distribution and a 5k-sample latency harness? Also check KV cache warm-up behavior for rerank.

li_research: Yep — I'll request a 5k-sample latency harness from Sapphire and run fp16 vs 4-bit quant comparisons to measure accuracy delta vs latency/cost tradeoffs. I'll post perf matrix in the ticket.

emily_cs: Next steps: 1) legal sign DPA, 2) olivia to confirm PHI gating / checklist, 3) raj to reserve Dedicated POC, 4) li runs evals, 5) marta provides cost estimate. I'll schedule a 30m sync tomorrow 11:00 PT. @onboarding-bot please create a kickoff ticket. :calendar:

onboarding-bot: Created ticket INF-4521: "Sapphire adaptive reranker POC". Assignees: raj_eng, li_research, olivia_se, marta_ops. Due: 2026-03-14. Link: https://issues.redwood.com/INF-4521

marta_ops: Ballpark cost for 2xA100 reserved POC: ~$1.8k/week plus engineering time. Will refine after perf runs.

olivia_se: Quick checklist to send to Sapphire: data schema, sample PHI redaction examples, SOC2 contact, encryption-at-rest confirmation, and whether they require HSM/KMS with customer-managed keys.

emily_cs: Thanks — I'll chase legal and product contact (sara@sapphire-retail.com) and upload the sanitized dataset when available. If anyone can't make tomorrow's sync or needs to reassign, ping here. :thumbsup:
